riskBands.High: a 1 in 30 (3.3%) or greater chance of flooding in any year
riskBands.Medium: less than 1 in 30 but at least 1 in 100 (1%) chance in any year

caveats: The file lists only postcodes with properties in or near areas at risk, so a district's share is measured over those postcodes, not over every home in the district: it overstates district-wide risk.
Counts are residential properties only (home insurance), from the RES_* columns.
District-level summaries are coarse: the Environment Agency states the data is not suitable for identifying whether an individual property will flood.
Covers flooding from rivers and the sea in England only (not surface water, groundwater, Wales or Scotland).
